title: 第25章 不是好人
content_zh:
“你现在出来，就算是没事了吧？”谷川问道：“有什么说法吗？”

    陆穿说道：“我是没事的。

    这次的事主要在小王总身上，我也就是一个打配合的，而且之前没确定的法律条文，所以算是下不为例。”

    说是下不为例，但坏处还是不少的。

    至少他下次电影的宣发，绝对被重点关注，一旦有点差错，他就要二进宫了。

    “那不会没收非法所得吧？”谷川问道。

    “啊？”

    陆穿看着谷川，没明白他这话的意思。

    谷川平静地说道：“就是电影的票房啊。”

    陆穿挠了挠头。

    这算是非法所得吗？

    “这倒是没说。”

    “那就是不没收。”谷川说道。

    现在他穷得叮当响，可不能被没收了啊，他还占百分之十的投资份额呢。

    九千多万的票房，不少钱了。

    谷川粗略地算了一下。

    这些钱院线拿大头，他占投资份额的百分之十，再缴税，谷川大概有三百万。

    嘶~

    不枉他中美来回飞，终于赚到第一桶金了。

    嗯，小刘那六千美元不算。

    他不好问这钱什么时候才能到手，小王总还没出来呢，不能太急切了。

    不过这次小王总恐怕有点麻烦，他以后和华谊合作，也不能这么亲密无间了。

    唉~

    陆穿现在能比较心平气和地跟自己说话，那是因为他没事。

    虽然自己很无辜，虽然自己也劝过小王总，但小王总心里肯定是有一根刺的。

    而大王总那边，自己都回国了，他都没个电话打过来，这让他十分心寒。

    不就是小王总可能出事吗？

    国内的九千多万票房可不是假的。

    冯裤子现在都没这票房。

    谷川对陆穿说道：“我已经安慰过陆叔了，你不用担心他。”

    “谢谢啊。”陆穿诧异地看着谷川。

    没想到他还挺心细的，这方面都考虑到了。

    “没什么谢不谢的。”谷川说道。

    这边陆穿刚出来，华谊的王忠军，还在为他那个弟弟奔波呢。

    他也知道谷川回国了，但也没空搭理他。
content_en:
"If you come out now, you'll be fine, right?" Tanichuan asked, "Do you have any explanation?"

    Lu Chuan said: "I'm fine.

    This time the incident is mainly about Mr. Xiao Wang, and I am the one who cooperates, and there are no legal provisions that have been determined before, so it will not be an example next time. "

    It won't happen next time, but there are still many disadvantages.

    At least the announcement of his next movie will definitely be focused on. If something goes wrong, he will enter the palace for the second time.

    "Then the illegal gains will not be confiscated, right?" Tanichuan asked.

    "Huh?"

    Lu Chuan looked at Gu Chuan, not understanding what he meant.

    Tanichuan said calmly: "It's just the box office of the movie."

    Lu Chuan scratched his head.

    Is this considered illegal income?

    "That's not true."

    "That means no confiscation." Tanichuan said.

    Now that he is extremely poor, he cannot be confiscated. He still holds 10% of the investment share.

    The box office is more than 90 million, which is a lot of money.

    Tanichuan did a rough calculation.

    The theater chain gets the lion's share of the money, and he accounts for 10% of the investment share. After paying taxes, Tanichuan has about three million.

    Hiss~

    It was no wonder that he flew back and forth between China and the United States and finally made his first pot of gold.

    Well, Xiao Liu’s six thousand dollars doesn’t count.

    It's hard for him to ask when he will get the money. Mr. Wang hasn't come out yet, so he can't be too eager.

    However, Mr. Wang may be in some trouble this time. He will not be able to be so close to Huayi in the future.

    Alas~

    Lu Chuan can talk to himself more calmly now, because he is fine.

    Although he was innocent, and although he had tried to persuade Mr. Wang, Mr. Wang must have felt a thorn in his heart.

    As for Mr. Wang, he had returned to China and he didn't even get a call, which made him very disappointed.

    Isn't it possible that something might happen to Xiao Wang?

    The domestic box office of more than 90 million is not fake.

    Feng Pants doesn’t have this box office now.

    Tanichuan said to Lu Chuan: "I have already comforted Uncle Lu, you don't have to worry about him."

    "Thank you." Lu Chuan looked at Gu Chuan in surprise.

    Unexpectedly, he was quite attentive and took all this into consideration.

    "No thanks." Tanichuan said.

    Lu Chuan has just come out here, and Wang Zhongjun of Huayi is still running around for his younger brother.

    He also knew that Tanichuan had returned to China, but he had no time to pay attention to him.
